completeness.note: Covers what the mint account and its Token-2022 extensions declare, plus the largest holders the endpoint would name. It does not cover liquidity: whether the pool is locked or burned, how deep it is, or whether a transfer-hook program behaves. Those need pool-level reads this does not do.
